```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
})

# ---- Input/Output paths ----
COUNT_MATRIX <- "~/claude_projects/nmd/sqanti/nmd_lungcells/results/nmd_lungcells_filtered.count_matrix.txt"
GTF_FILE     <- "~/claude_projects/nmd/sqanti/nmd_lungcells/results/nmd_lungcells_filtered.gtf"
OUT_DIR      <- "../isocall_dge"

dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- Volcano plot helper ----
plot_volcano <- function(df, design_name, coef_name) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      negLogP = -log10(P.Value),
      sig = ifelse(adj.P.Val < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Sig")
    )

  top_hits <- df %>%
    filter(sig == "Significant") %>%
    arrange(P.Value) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)

  rest <- df[!rownames(df) %in% rownames(top_hits), ]

  set.seed(42)
  random_subset <- rest %>%
    mutate(pval_bin = ntile(P.Value, 100)) %>%
    group_by(pval_bin) %>%
    slice_sample(prop = 1) %>%
    slice_head(n = 50) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-pval_bin)

  plot_df <- rbind(top_hits, random_subset)

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = logFC, y = negLogP)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = sig), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "red", "Not Sig" = "gray")) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = top_hits,
      aes(label = gene_name),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = 10,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.3,
      segment.color = "grey50"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Volcano Plot — ", design_name, "\nCoefficient: ", coef_name),
      x = "log2 Fold Change",
      y = expression(-log[10]("P-value"))
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

# ---- Helper: extract topTable, round, sort ----
process_ct <- function(fit2, coef_name) {
  res <- topTable(fit2, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, confint = TRUE)
  num_cols <- c("logFC", "CI.L", "CI.R", "AveExpr", "t", "B")
  res[num_cols] <- round(res[num_cols], 3)
  res[order(res$P.Value), ]
}
```

# Load count matrix and gene annotation

```{r}
# ---- Read isocall count matrix ----
raw <- fread(COUNT_MATRIX, data.table = FALSE)
txids <- raw$id
counts <- as.matrix(raw[, -1])
rownames(counts) <- txids

cat("Count matrix:", nrow(counts), "isoforms x", ncol(counts), "samples\n")

# ---- Parse gene annotation from isocall GTF ----
gtf <- fread(GTF_FILE,header = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = "")
gtf<-gtf[gtf$V3 %in% "transcript",]

gtf$transcript_id <- gsub('.*transcript_id "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', gtf$V9)
gtf$gene_id       <- gsub('.*gene_id "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', gtf$V9)
gtf$gene_name     <- gsub('.*gene_name "([^"]+)".*', '\\1', gtf$V9)

gdf <- gtf[, c("transcript_id", "gene_id", "gene_name")]
gdf <- gdf[!duplicated(gdf$transcript_id), ]

# Match to count matrix row order
gdf <- gdf[match(txids, gdf$transcript_id), ]
stopifnot(all(gdf$transcript_id == txids))

cat("Gene annotation:", nrow(gdf), "transcripts,",
    length(unique(gdf$gene_id)), "genes\n")
```

# Build phenotype and DGEList

```{r}
# ---- Parse phenotype from sample names ----
# Format: Sample{N}_{CT}_{DONOR}_{TREATMENT}
# DD_ALI has underscore in CT, so parse from ends:
#   treatment = last field, donor = second-to-last, CT = middle fields
sample_names <- colnames(counts)
parts_list <- strsplit(sample_names, "_")

pheno <- data.frame(
  sample     = sample_names,
  sample_num = as.integer(gsub("Sample", "", sapply(parts_list, `[`, 1))),
  treatment  = sapply(parts_list, function(x) x[length(x)]),
  id         = sapply(parts_list, function(x) x[length(x) - 1]),
  ct         = sapply(parts_list, function(x) paste(x[2:(length(x) - 2)], collapse = "_")),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Cell types:", paste(sort(unique(pheno$ct)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Treatments:", paste(sort(unique(pheno$treatment)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
table(pheno$ct, pheno$treatment)

# ---- Create DGEList ----
dge <- DGEList(counts, samples = pheno, genes = gdf)

saveRDS(dge, file = file.path(OUT_DIR, "dgelist_isocall_2026.3.1.rds"))

# ---- Filter lowly expressed isoforms ----
design_all <- model.matrix(~ treatment + ct + ct * treatment, data = dge$samples)

keep <- filterByExpr(dge, design = design_all, min.count = 5, min.total.count = 10, min.prop = 0)
cat("Isoforms retained =", sum(keep), "\n")

dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# ---- TMM normalization ----
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
quantile(dge$samples$norm.factors)

cat("DGEList:", nrow(dge$samples), "samples,", nrow(dge$counts), "isoforms\n")

# ---- Voom + PCA ----
v <- voom(dge, plot = TRUE)
pca <- prcomp(t(v$E), scale. = TRUE)
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2])
var_exp <- round(100 * (pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2))[1:2], 1)

pca_df$treatment <- dge$samples$treatment
pca_df$id        <- dge$samples$id
pca_df$ct        <- dge$samples$ct
pca_df$color     <- ifelse(pca_df$treatment == "DMSO", "orange", "purple")

p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = color, label = ct)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA: Treatment (color), Cell Type (label)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
print(p)

table(dge$samples$ct)
```

# Fit Model

```{r}
design_all <- model.matrix(~ treatment + ct + treatment * ct, data = dge$samples)

cat("Design matrix columns:", colnames(design_all), "\n")

v <- voom(dge, design = design_all, plot = TRUE)

# ---- Duplicate correlation (blocking on donor) ----
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(v, design_all, block = dge$samples$id)
cat("Consensus correlation:", corfit$consensus.correlation, "\n")

# ---- Fit linear model ----
fit <- lmFit(v, design_all, block = dge$samples$id,
             correlation = corfit$consensus.correlation)
fit <- eBayes(fit)

plotSA(fit, main = "Residual SD vs Avg Expression")

# ---- Contrast matrix: Smg1i effect within each cell type ----
colnames(fit$design)       <- make.names(colnames(fit$design))
colnames(fit$coefficients) <- colnames(fit$design)

contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  Smg1i_in_AT     = treatmentSmg1i,
  Smg1i_in_DD     = treatmentSmg1i + treatmentSmg1i.ctDD,
  Smg1i_in_DD_ALI = treatmentSmg1i + treatmentSmg1i.ctDD_ALI,
  Smg1i_in_DO     = treatmentSmg1i + treatmentSmg1i.ctDO,
  Smg1i_in_FB     = treatmentSmg1i + treatmentSmg1i.ctFB,
  Smg1i_in_MV     = treatmentSmg1i + treatmentSmg1i.ctMV,
  levels = fit$design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
```

# Results

```{r include=FALSE}
dielist <- list()
```

## DD

```{r}
treatment_res <- process_ct(fit2, "Smg1i_in_DD")

table(treatment_res$adj.P.Val <= 0.05)
table(treatment_res$adj.P.Val <= 0.05, treatment_res$logFC > 0,
      dnn = c("FDR sig", "logFC>0"))

plot_volcano(treatment_res, "DD", "Smg1i_in_DD")

temp <- treatment_res[treatment_res$adj.P.Val <= 0.05,
  c("transcript_id", "gene_name", "gene_id", "logFC", "AveExpr", "adj.P.Val", "P.Value")]
datatable(head(temp, 1000), rownames = FALSE)

fwrite(treatment_res, file = file.path(OUT_DIR, "nmd_isocall_dge_dd_2026.3.1.csv"))
dielist[["DD"]] <- treatment_res
```
